record.paper_title: The average size of a connected vertex set of a graph-Explicit formulas and open problems
record.original_question: Let P_n be the path on n vertices and let P_n x P_n be the n by n Cartesian-product grid graph. If N(G) denotes the number of vertex subsets U of a graph G whose induced subgraph is connected, find a formula for N(P_n x P_n), the number of connected vertex sets of the n by n grid.

evidence.quote: Question 2. Find a formula for the number N ( × P P n n) of connected sets of the n n × grid.

artifact.self_contained_problem: For a finite simple graph $G=(V,E)$, call a nonempty subset $U\subseteq V$ a connected set if the subgraph of $G$ induced by $U$ is connected, and let $N(G)$ denote the number of connected sets of $G$. Let $P_n$ denote the path on $n$ vertices, and let $P_n\square P_n$ denote the Cartesian product of $P_n$ with itself, i.e., the $n\times n$ grid graph whose vertex set is $\{1,\dots,n\}\times\{1,\dots,n\}$ and in which two vertices are adjacent if and only if they differ by $1$ in exactly one coordinate. Determine a closed-form formula (as a function of $n$) for $N(P_n\square P_n)$, the number of connected vertex subsets of the $n\times n$ grid graph.
artifact.category_tag: connected subgraph enumeration in grid graphs
artifact.status_search_result: No closed-form formula for the number of connected vertex subsets of the n×n grid graph appears in the literature or in OEIS. Related work by Vince and Haslegrave on connected sets in graphs treats families such as paths, cycles, and ladders, but the square-grid case is left as an open problem; no resolution has been found in subsequent literature.

status_evidence.title: The average size of a connected vertex set of a graph
status_evidence.snippet: Question 2. Find a formula for the number N(P_n × P_n) of connected sets of the n × n grid.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is explicitly posed as an open question.

status_evidence.title: Counting connected sets and connected partitions of a graph
status_evidence.snippet: Formulas for connected sets are obtained for specific graph families such as ladders, but not square grids.
status_evidence.claim: Follow-up work does not provide a formula for n×n grids.
